notes: Backup-only: positional stamps are salted per (row, field) and carry no cross-row information; the retained 16-bit candidate tokens leak exactly as A/B (mission-1 and unified numbers apply). Known rows do not help the log attack (piece keys stay secret), so the positional attack is independent of the 0.01/0.1/1 % levels.
Stamps modeled as collision-free labels (64-bit sha256 truncation: per-check collision 2^-64).
